headless.name: CHARACTER_GET_AGENT_AVATARS
headless.query: query GetAgentAvatars($agentAddress: Address!) { stateQuery { agent(address: $agentAddress) { gold crystal avatarStates { address index } } } }

headless.name: CHARACTER_GET_STAKE_STATE
headless.query: query GetStakeState($agentAddress: Address!) { stateQuery { stakeState(address: $agentAddress) { deposit } } }

headless.name: CHARACTER_GET_AVATAR_INVENTORY_EQUIPMENTS
headless.query: query GetAvatarInventoryEquipments($avatarAddress: Address!) { stateQuery { avatar(avatarAddress: $avatarAddress) { inventory { equipments { id itemId equipped statsMap { hP aTK dEF cRI hIT sPD } skills { id } } } } } }

mimir.name: BLOCKS_GET_LATEST
mimir.query: query GetLatestBlock { blocks(skip: 0, take: 1) { items { id object { hash index miner stateRootHash timestamp txCount txIds } } } }

mimir.name: BLOCKS_GET_LIST
mimir.query: query GetBlocks($skip: Int!, $take: Int!) { blocks(skip: $skip, take: $take) { items { id object { hash index miner stateRootHash timestamp txCount } } } }

mimir.name: CHARACTER_GET_AVATAR_MIMIR_SIMPLE
mimir.query: query GetAvatarMimirSimple($avatarAddress: Address!, $agentAddress: Address!) { actionPoint(address: $avatarAddress) dailyRewardReceivedBlockIndex(address: $avatarAddress) ncg: balance(address: $agentAddress, currencyTicker: "NCG") myAdventureCpRanking(address: $avatarAddress) { rank userDocument { avatar { armorId portraitId } cp } } avatar(address: $avatarAddress) { level name exp stageMap { key value } } isHasCraftOneTime:transactions( filter: { actionTypeId: "combination_equipment17" avatarAddress: $avatarAddress } skip: 0 take: 1 ) { items { id } } isClaimPatrolRewardOneTime:transactions( filter: { actionTypeId: "claim_patrol_reward" avatarAddress: $avatarAddress } skip: 0 take: 1 ) { items { id } } }

mimir.name: TRANSACTION_GET_STATUS
mimir.query: query GetTransactionStatus($txHash: String!) { transaction(txId: $txHash) { object { txStatus } } }
